title: Text: DET Ron Colangelo ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Do you have Perry Farrell's phone number?
Do you have an email for Chris Thomas? One I have bounced back. I'm pissed at Perry. Very sloppy on his part.
And here I thought you were calling to congratulate me on my AP Sports Editors honor
All set. Spoke with Chris and it's been updated. Thanks for the assist.
